body: The clear (X) button inside the expanded search input is icon-only and has no accessible name. Add an `aria-label` (e.g., "Clear search") or an `sr-only` text node so screen readers can identify the control.

The collapsed Search button hides its text label via `hidden sm:inline`, so on small screens it may end up with no accessible name (icon-only). Provide an `aria-label`/`title` or `sr-only` text so it remains discoverable and so tests can reliably query it by accessible name.

After removing the toolbar controls (FilterUI/SortUI/Search/Refresh), there is still leftover filter/sort/search/refresh-related logic in this component (e.g., schema flags like `showSearch`/`showFilters`/`showRefresh`, and the Filter/Sort schema generation + refresh handler). That code path is now unused and is likely to trigger lint failures for unused variables, and it also makes the `ObjectView` API misleading. Either reintroduce controls when `ObjectView` is used standalone, or remove/deprecate the related schema flags and delete the unused logic to match the new toolbar responsibilities.

Several toolbar buttons rely on a label wrapped in `hidden sm:inline`, which is `display:none` on small screens. That removes the accessible name, leaving icon-only buttons without an aria label (e.g., Hide fields / Filter / Group / Sort / Color / Row height). Add an `aria-label` (and optionally `title`) or use an `sr-only` label so the buttons remain accessible when the visible text is hidden.
